'The next time an attack action card hits a hero this turn, it deals 1 damage to them. / If Electrify is played from arsenal, draw a card. / Go again.'

GO AGAIN deliberately NOT authored: GoAgain is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field; re-authoring a printed keyword is a defect.

CLAUSE 1: INJECT_TRIGGER scope=TURN puts the hook on the controller's turn_attack_hooks, re-applied to EVERY attack for the rest of the turn and cleared at end of turn (engine.py:1238-1273; INJECT_TRIGGER handler effect_types.py:2103-2179). 'The NEXT time' needs single-fire, and TURN hooks are NEVER consumed after firing (the bluff_catcher_yellow triage finding), so the inner trigger self-consumes via a flag: the first qualifying hit sets electrify_damage_spent on the attacker's current_turn_effects (SET_FLAG defaults player SELF = controller of the card the trigger fired on) and every later hit this turn fails NOT FLAG_SET. The anchoring is sound in practice: an Action card can only be played during its controller's action phase, and the TURN hook expires at that same turn's end - so every attack the hook can ever see belongs to Electrify's controller, and attacker-relative SELF resolves to the same player every time. (A mixed-controller turn would be the only way the flag anchors inconsistently; the engine does not produce one.)

INNER SHAPE: conditions/effects nested under the trigger dict - REQUIRED, because a top-level conditions key is popped by the loader as an effect-level gate evaluated ONCE at registration, when there may be no attack (effect_types.py:2104-2119 comment). ATTACK_TYPE_IN unions the attack card's types AND subtypes (condition_types.py ~273-294), so ['Action'] matches exactly attack ACTION cards; weapon attacks carry type Weapon and do not qualify - matching the printed 'an attack action card'. ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gates 'hits a hero'; DEAL_GENERIC then resolves target OPPONENT relative to the ATTACKER (_damage_target_player), i.e. the hero that was hit - 'it deals 1 damage to THEM'. Generic damage per the release note ('the damage is not arcane damage'); the attack action card is recorded as the damage source because the trigger fires with c=combat.attack_card.

CLAUSE 2: DRAW amount 1 gated by EFFECT-LEVEL conditions PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL - the loader pops a conditions key inside an effect object into a resolution-time gate (loader.py:82-90); the condition reads played_from_zone stamped at the moment of play, falling back to prev_zone (condition_types.py:789-809). Ability-level conditions would behave identically here (both check at resolution), but the effect-level gate keeps the condition attached to the one clause it scopes.

No known gaps.
